Name: CP and AT - Frog Sprinklers
Author: joondanoon
Description:
[i]Regular sprinklers are a simple frog buddy.[/i]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/BHrw53hK/texture-1.png[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/SXRKqWtL/texture-10.png[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/xtK19CYp/texture-17.png[/img]﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/PGjv9CCz/texture-23.png[/img]﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/6c9rF7Yz/texture-15.png[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/RGF7ShFd/texture-32.png[/img]﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/ZzFBPHvH/texture-30.png[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/vCQ465jk/texture-39.png[/img]
[i]Quality sprinklers gain a friend.
[/i]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/kV6vNx1j/texture-2.png[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/YBsq6v8Z/texture-9.png[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/jv8RCBJ1/texture-15.png[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/TqNYTT44/texture-18.png[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/0pPZsSPw/texture-21.png[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/KjVwN0Xr/texture-29.png[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/LDK14X7d/texture-32.png[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/yFV42hx2/texture-40.png[/img]
[i]Iridium Sprinklers get crowned as the frog kings.[/i]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/d0BKjdxY/texture-111.png[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/Mx1wtmwJ/texture-94.png[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/hFbQ166P/texture-87.png[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/8nBFvYC4/texture-65.png[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/204z1sKd/texture-53.png[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/YTTgr9Qn/texture-41.png[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/Zpd3VLBx/texture-17.png[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/gbN2RVhv/texture-9.png[/img]
[i]Enhance your frogs with a little pool by adding the Pressure Nozzle, or give them a little Enricher hat to increase crop growth gains.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/mVrcMTMJ/texture-87-pn.png[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/whqwFXsK/texture-87-e.png[/img][/i]

[list]
[*]Customize Frog color, Leaf color, and Crown color in configs
[/list][list]
[*]200 total combinations :)
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/LXLCHNrT/what-version-do-i-install.png[/img]﻿
If you want to replace the vanilla sprinklers, and want all your sprinklers to be the same type of frog, install the [b]CP version.[/b]
If you want to be able to have the frog sprinklers and the vanilla sprinklers, install the [b]AT version.[/b]
If you want to have the frog sprinklers, and also retexture the vanilla sprinkler, install the [b]CP+AT version.

[/b]☆ [i]When using one of the versions including AT, it's highly recommended to randomize your frog-look with the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Spray-Can-Tool]Spray Can[/url] [/i]☆

[img]https://i.ibb.co/KVj3srt/installation.png[/img]

[b]☆ CP version ☆[/b]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿, [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM [/url]﻿(optional but HIGHLY recommended).
[*]﻿Unzip [CP] Frog Sprinklers into your Stardew Valley/mods folder.
[*]Edit the "config" file to your liking, or edit it in game, using GMCM.
[/list][b]☆ AT version ☆[/b]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿, [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM [/url]﻿(optional but HIGHLY recommended).
[*]﻿Unzip [AT] Frog Sprinklers into your Stardew Valley/mods folder.
[/list][b]☆ CP+AT version ☆[/b]
[list]
[*]Install[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿, [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿, [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][b]﻿[/b],[b] [/b]and[b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]GMCM [/b][/url][b]﻿[/b](optional but HIGHLY recommended).
[*]﻿Unzip [CP+AT] Frog Sprinklers into your Stardew Valley/mods folder.
[*]Edit the "config" file to your liking, or edit it in game, using GMCM.
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/fGqcwVT/credits.png[/img]

Original frog model by ConcernedApe

~

[/i]
